blindness: Verdicts formed from the retained review PNGs in datasets/paddle-bench/ownership-review/ BEFORE reading any owners values/notes in L-verdicts files or the ownership-review.json sidecar. Selection used only caseId/tMs/owners key-indices. Box identity = render color: 0=yellow, 1=lime, 2=red, 3=cyan.
taxonomy: TARGET | NOT_TARGET | AMBIGUOUS per box (3-class; sub-reason in note distinguishes other-player-paddle vs not-a-paddle for NOT_TARGET). Mapping to primary 4-class for agreement: target→TARGET, other→NOT_TARGET, reject→NOT_TARGET, ambiguous→AMBIGUOUS.
